acceptanceCriteria: With pressure limits configured and no eligible work or workers, consecutive ticks skip the store observation and pressure sample.
A test pins it, and pressure is still sampled before any launch.
body:
Filed 2026-10-07 by the orchestrator session.

Observed 2026-10-07 in the batch 4 integration review (Codex r1 P3, branch claude/rc3-batch-4, internal/tasks/dispatch/idle.go). When the dispatch config declares pressure limits, idle skipping is disabled, so every tick does a full store observation and pressure sample even with no workers and no eligible work. Owner goal: no CPU use unless essential. Expected: pressure sampling happens only when a launch is possible (eligible work and a free slot), and an otherwise idle loop still skips. Actual: full ticks continue at the base interval. The no-worker ps scan was fixed in batch 4 (f975e5a6). Related: V1-0894 (CPU budget) and V1-0913 (Tasks idle CPU at 10k tickets).
title: dispatch: a pressure configuration disables the idle skip even when nothing can launch
